issues.where: main arch and its two bright footpoints
issues.what: The glowing solar arch reads immediately against black space and could stop a scroll, but it is already fully formed in frame one. The later frames mostly shimmer within the same silhouette, so there is little visible payoff for staying.
issues.fix: Keep the bright arch readable in frame one, then send a clearly visible pulse from one footpoint over the crest to the other before the hook ends.
